# EU fixtures: RECONSTRUCTED, not captured live

The development sandbox could not reach any of the EU hosts (`ec.europa.eu`,
`agriculture.ec.europa.eu`, `api.tech.ec.europa.eu`, `webgate.ec.europa.eu`). **None of these
files was downloaded from the real source.** They were rebuilt from the documentation and
evidence collected in `docs/research/eu.json`, so that the formats are as close as possible to
the real ones. **All numbers and texts are illustrative test data, not market data.** The PDFs
say so on every page.

On the first live run, compare these fixtures with the real responses archived under
`data/raw/<source>/`, and update them where they differ.

| File | Source / collector | What is reconstructed, and from what |
|---|---|---|
| `comext_honey_2026-10-16.json`, `comext_honey_2026-11-13.json` | Eurostat Comext DS-045409, `eurostat_comext` | JSON-stat 2.0 *structure* (top-level keys, `id` order `freq, reporter, partner, product, flow, indicators, time`, sparse `value` dict keyed by the flat index, `category.index` objects, `extension.annotation`, `positions-with-no-data`) copied from a real DS-045409 response captured on 2026-10-16 (see the GitHub capture in the evidence list). The honey cells, labels and values are illustrative. The second file is a later "vintage" with one revised value (EU27 imports from CN, 2026-08) and one new month. |
| `comext_probe_2026-10-16.json`, `comext_probe_2026-11-13.json` | same | The small request used for the daily "has `updated` changed?" check. |
| `taxud_sectors.json`, `taxud_import_honey_2026.json`, `taxud_api_docs.json` | Agri-food Data Portal TAXUD weekly data, `ec_taxud_weekly` | Field names (`marketingYear`, `week`, `memberStateCode`, `partnerCode`, `cn8ProductCode`, `taric10ProductCode`, `kg`, `euroValue`, ...) are those that third-party clients validate against the live API. `importCategory` and `partnerName` are **unverified** field names. The OpenAPI spec is a minimal stand-in that only has the paths and parameters we check. The rows deliberately include a duplicate, a conflicting duplicate, a malformed `kg` and a customs pseudo-partner (`QW`). |
| `honey_page.html` | DG AGRI honey page, `ec_honey_market` | Europa Component Library (`ecl-file`) markup in the style of agriculture.ec.europa.eu pages. The January 2026 overview's UUID and filename are invented (research found its title and date, not its filename). The autumn 2024 URL is real. |
| `honey-market-overview-january-2026_en.pdf`, `market-presentation-honey_autumn2024_en.pdf` | same | Generated by `build_fixtures.py`. Page 2 of the overview holds one clearly structured price table (parsed). Page 3 has prices only in free text, and page 4 has a table under a title that names two price types. Neither of these is parsed. |
| `rasff_search_honey_p1.json` | RASFF Window backend, `rasff_honey` | The list-page shape (`totalPages`, `totalElements`, `notifications[]` with `notifId`, `reference`, `ecValidationDate` as `dd-mm-yyyy HH:MM:SS`, `subject`, `notifyingCountry`, `originCountries`, `productCategory`, `notificationClassification`, `riskDecision`) follows the HAR-derived docstring and parsing code of public clients. All notifications are invented, including one royal-jelly item that must be filtered out. |

`build_fixtures.py` regenerates the Comext JSON and the PDFs:
`cd backend && python tests/fixtures/eu/build_fixtures.py`.

Documentation and evidence used:

* Comext API: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/user-guides/data-browser/api-data-access/api-getting-started/comext-database
* Real DS-045409 JSON-stat capture (structure reference): https://github.com/Blackl1stV35/inter-trade-present/blob/c7a106143b6cd434c6d0841b6dd8e6bda5f0c7bc/data/comext_exports/raw/probe_pre1999_EXT_EU27_2020.json
* TAXUD weekly data API: https://agridata.ec.europa.eu/extensions/API_Documentation/taxud.html and https://agridata.ec.europa.eu/extensions/API_Documentation/API-Guide.html
* TAXUD field validation in client code: https://github.com/dheera/fin-data/blob/d8fd052a286f6cc2a09bbcd2ba0d18c3cf0cc491/alt_data/sources_economy4.py
* DG AGRI honey page: https://agriculture.ec.europa.eu/farming/animal-products/honey_en
* Autumn 2024 presentation: https://agriculture.ec.europa.eu/document/download/c04a9774-5ba3-41f5-b256-08396b2888ec_en?filename=market-presentation-honey_autumn2024_en.pdf
* RASFF Window: https://webgate.ec.europa.eu/rasff-window/screen/search, plus client code https://github.com/bcyruce/OpenFoodAlerts/blob/dd08e293b96d3a42cfb7c3b17ae55dd35670b59a/pipeline/src/openfoodalerts/sources/rasff/client.py and https://github.com/ultramagnus23/FoodSafe/blob/121be5c3f932e722639fb86c916a679660074ad7/pipeline/sources/rasff.py
